desc:
🎮 Welcome to GameStation!

Available Consoles:
PS5 • PS4 • Xbox One • Xbox 360 • Windows 11

Experience a collection of gaming consoles, from classic retro systems to modern next-gen platforms! Unlock consoles, explore their unique interfaces, and play a variety of Roblox games through each system.

🖥️ PC Controls:
- Enter – Select
- Backspace – Go Back
- Tab – Switch Menu
- T – Additional Options
- E – Interact
- H – Home Menu

🎮 Console Controls:
- Use your controller to navigate menus and select games.
- Press the designated Home button to return to the main menu.
